verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents a standalone Tax Calculations API that computes tax from customer location, with an IP-geolocation estimate before the postal address is known, and a community user reports calculation based on the full customer address. Nothing in the evidence establishes rooftop-level accuracy over ZIP-level approximation, or any latency or performance figures for use inside checkout. missing for 10: documented rooftop/address-level geocoding accuracy, documented latency or checkout-speed guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration of accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can calculate the right sales tax for a transaction through an API in real time — address-level (rooftop) accuracy, not ZIP-code approximations — fast enough to sit inside checkout

citations.quote: The standalone Tax Calculations and Tax Transactions APIs lets you calculate tax, record transactions, and handle reversals directly.
A Tax Calculation allows you to calculate the tax to collect from your customer.
determining tax rates based on product type, customer location, and business location
Use this to show your customer a tax estimate before they provide their postal address.
Stripe tax does all of that automatically, based on the customer full address and VAT numbers.
